exchanges: so i finally unpacked everything and my room looks like a storage unit exploded i dont know how i fit all of this in one car
Unpacking always takes longer than it seems. What is still left to sort out?
mostly clothes and like four boxes of instant noodles my mom packed because she thinks i wont eat otherwise
That sounds like a mom move. At least you will not go hungry.
honestly fair. the guy across the hall mateo came over to say hi he seems cool
Nice to meet someone right away. Did you two get to talk much?
yeah for like an hour he drove up from home in this beat up Jetta with no AC and all his stuff piled in the back
That sounds like a rough drive in the heat.
lol he said the window doesnt even roll down. anyway he was telling me hes learning Mandarin because his girlfriends family speaks it and he wants to impress them at new year
That is a sweet reason to pick up a language.
i know right. meanwhile i tried to get people in the common room to watch the game with me and nobody here cares about hockey?? i have bled Canucks blue since i was five
Tough crowd. There might be a club on campus for hockey fans.
maybe ill look. my sister ji-woo texted me a pic from the climbing gym she basically lives there now doing bouldering four nights a week
She sounds hooked. Is she any good?
shes scary good like she does the purple routes which are the hard ones apparently
Impressive, those must take a lot of strength.
then hana my brothers wife saw the pic and said ji-woo should come to her pottery class instead because its calmer lol
That is a fun little in-law rivalry.
they are both competitive in a nice way. my brother jun just stays out of it
Smart of him.
jun is the reason i even got here he drove me the whole way in his Corolla with me crying half the time
That was kind of him. The first goodbye is hard.
ok so first calc lecture for my economics degree and the prof dr adeyemi is honestly hilarious
A funny professor makes early lectures much easier.
he spent ten minutes talking about growing up in Ibadan and how his math teacher used to throw chalk
Sounds like he has good stories.
then he gave us a quiz on day one which is evil
That is a bold first move.
oh and get this sofia from high school is at Concordia now and she already joined like six clubs which is so on brand
She sounds like she is diving right in.
shes gonna burn out by october but whatever
Hopefully she paces herself.
update mateo just knocked to borrow a pan and corrected me its Cantonese not mandarin i had it wrong this whole time
Good thing he set it straight before you said anything to his girlfriend.
lmao exactly. he made fried rice with the pan and the whole floor smells amazing
That is a great way to make friends on a floor.
true. honestly if i could cook one thing it would be tteokbokki its my favourite food ever
That is a fun one to learn, and the sauce is not too hard.
we had our floor meeting and the ra said no candles which, ok
Fire rules in residence are strict for good reason.
also it rains here constantly i need better shoes
Waterproof boots would be worth it in this city.
my mom says she will send some but she will pick the ugliest ones
Moms do tend to pick practical over stylish.
probably. ok tired but cant sleep
Maybe something to watch would help you wind down.
maybe ill put on Severance again ive seen it twice already
A rewatch is easy to fall asleep to.
oh yeah i went to the drugstore earlier and bought a kettle so i can make tea in my room which is probably against the rules too
Those are usually allowed, but check the residence guide to be safe.
ill check. tea is the only thing keeping me alive this week
A warm drink at night can help a lot.
wait what was the thing hana said she does again, the calmer one

earlier_question.right_reply: Hana does pottery, she goes to a class for it.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Hana does bouldering, she goes most nights.
